fusions.name: Grip-and-Fling
fusions.desc: Seizes the target with your feet and flings it 3 tiles away, dealing 14 damage and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Canopy Drop
fusions.desc: Leaps high and drops feet-first, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit, with a 50% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Four-Handed
fusions.desc: Swings you 2 tiles from where you stood, then your attack speed rises by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Cuffed in Passing
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 20% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
